title: Inside the Kubernetes Scheduler
abstract: How the scheduler filters and scores nodes, why pods end up where they do, and how to use topology spread and priority classes to place workloads on busy clusters.
speaker: Priya Venkatesan

title: Following a Request Across Thirty Microservices
abstract: A practical guide to distributed tracing: propagating context, sampling without losing the interesting requests, and finding the one slow dependency behind a latency spike.
speaker: Tomasz Wrona

title: Postgres Connection Pooling Under Bursty Traffic
abstract: Why autoscaled application pods can exhaust a database's connections, how transaction pooling helps, and which session features stop working when you turn it on.
speaker: Amara Okafor

title: Least-Privilege RBAC for Multi-Tenant Clusters
abstract: Designing roles that teams can actually live with, auditing permissions that have quietly grown over time, and keeping tenants from reading each other's secrets.
speaker: Lucia Herrera

title: Computer Vision on a Budget at the Edge
abstract: Running object detection on small CPUs: exporting models to ONNX, choosing resolution and frame rate, and sending only results upstream to protect privacy and bandwidth.
speaker: Kenji Nakamura

title: GitOps Across a Fleet of Clusters
abstract: Structuring repositories and promotion stages when one team deploys to hundreds of clusters, and what to do when drift and failed syncs arrive at the same time.
speaker: Sofia Lindqvist

title: Zero-Downtime Schema Migrations
abstract: Expand-and-contract migrations for busy relational databases: adding columns and indexes without long locks, backfilling safely, and rolling back when a release goes wrong.
speaker: Daniel Mbeki

title: Serving Large Language Models on Kubernetes
abstract: Packing GPUs efficiently, batching inference requests, and autoscaling on queue depth when model weights take minutes to load into memory.
speaker: Fatima Al-Sayed

title: Debugging Network Policy with eBPF
abstract: When a connection is silently dropped, eBPF tools show which rule did it. A walkthrough of tracing packets through the node and fixing policies without guesswork.
speaker: Marek Novak

title: Who Spent That? Cost Allocation for Shared Clusters
abstract: Attributing compute and storage spend to teams, setting useful requests and limits, and building cost reports that lead engineers to change something.
speaker: Grace Adeyemi

title: Semantic Search for Internal Documentation
abstract: Building search that understands questions rather than keywords: chunking documents, comparing sparse and dense retrieval, and measuring whether results actually improved.
speaker: Hannah Fischer

title: SLOs That Developers Actually Use
abstract: Choosing indicators that reflect user pain, setting error budgets that change priorities, and replacing noisy alerts with burn-rate alerts people trust.
speaker: Rafael Costa

title: Canary Releases Without the Fear
abstract: Shifting traffic gradually, deciding automatically from metrics whether a release is healthy, and aborting safely when a new version misbehaves.
speaker: Ingrid Solberg

title: Service Mesh mTLS: What It Does and Doesn't Protect
abstract: Certificates, workload identity and authorization policy in a mesh, plus the threats mutual TLS leaves open and how to close them.
speaker: Yusuf Demir

title: Backups You Can Actually Restore
abstract: Point-in-time recovery for stateful workloads and databases on Kubernetes, rehearsing restores, and setting recovery objectives before an outage forces the issue.
speaker: Chloe Dubois

title: Sharding Postgres Without Downtime
abstract: When one primary is no longer enough: picking a shard key, splitting tables while serving traffic, and handling cross-shard queries as data keeps growing.
speaker: Arjun Mehta

title: Operating Highly Available Postgres on Kubernetes
abstract: Running replicated relational databases with an operator: automated failover, rolling upgrades of the database, and storage choices that hold up under load.
speaker: Elena Petrova

title: Vector Search Inside Your Relational Database
abstract: Adding similarity search to an existing database with vector indexes: how they scale, when query performance falls off, and when you need a dedicated search engine.
speaker: Minh Tran

title: Signing Container Images for a Safer Supply Chain
abstract: Keyless signing, build provenance and admission checks that stop unverified images from reaching production, with an honest look at the operational cost.
speaker: Olivia Brandt

title: Designing Developer Portals People Enjoy
abstract: Accessible navigation, useful service catalogs and good defaults: lessons from user research on why engineers abandon internal tools and what brings them back.
speaker: Noor Rahman
